description: Resource and data source address shapes the TypeScript parser rewrites to a reference key on the next regeneration (conformance/hcl/README.md, rule 21). The provider refuses every one of them with REF_EXPRESSION_REFUSED. An address of a type absent here is refused by the parser too (REF_SUGAR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE); module aliases, lex bots and views are key-form only. The reference name is the inverse of slugIdentifier: a leading underscore is stripped only before a digit, underscores become hyphens, and the result must match the slug pattern.
refused: any address whose label is not a slug identifier
